not_rerun: KUnit execution of the DCP fabric timeout test
J314S wip4 boot or WD22TB4 first-plug/retry/recovery test
matching-device camera, SMC telemetry or eGPU hardware qualification
suspend/resume, rollback boot, and 64-fix semantic parity
known_interactions: #158 and #157 remain unmerged upstream proposals and must be re-pinned if their heads move.
The local DCP patch treats a timed-out release as complete; a slow-but-live endpoint remains the principal risk. A tunnel already assigned to the silent pipeline is not moved in that same plug.
PR #135 thermal behavior is not wired to the #158 M3 runtime because runtime startup is intentionally refused.
PR #119 camera support requires matching m1n1 ISP-heap changes and device firmware; the camera ports do not qualify J314S.
The eGPU profile is a separate package identity, with no claim of card, display-output, BAR or compute operation.

build_evidence.package_inspection: passed in each build job; artifacts contain payload-only packages, source, provenance and checksums
